spans.s:
The word युवा 'young' is compounded with the words खलति 'bald headed', पलित 'grey-haired', वलिन 'wrinkled', जरति 'decayed', when they are in agreement (same case) and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

Before the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् , कन् is optionally substituted for युवन् and अल्प।

Terms: इष्ठन् and इयसुन्

For यु and वु (nasalized) in an affix, are substituted, respectively, अन and अक।

Terms: Some substitution

In the dual, युव is substituted for युष्म् and आव for अस्म्।

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्
